data: What is the name of the model with the highest performance for SPICE?

The question asks for the name of the model with the highest performance for SPICE. From the caption, we know that Att2in+BSx is Att2in+fixLen with beam size x. 

Looking at the graph for SPICE, we can see four lines representing different models: LenEmb, Marker, Att2in+BS5, and Att2in+BS10. The line corresponding to LenEmb appears to be the highest among all the lines. Therefore, the model with the highest performance for SPICE is LenEmb.
